You see a red gem.
It weighs 0.30 oz.

    Notes

    It's one of the most common gems. The Red Gem can be obtained through the Bright Sword Quest, Double Hero Quest, The First Dragon Quest, The Lost Brother Quest, Children of the Revolution Quest "supplies" daily task, The Great Dragon Hunt Quest and the Rise of Devovorga World Quest. Can also be obtained from Gnomish Supply Packages.
